content: GOAL: ground each of the three proposals in the frozen bundle before ranking. READ: the three bundles' E5-E13 (all three share E1-E11 behavioural evidence), and the scope contract / experiment policy. OBSERVED: E6 width-20 beam survival shows recall@10 0.04671 (l1_br), 0.06207 (l1_br_euclid), 0.06233 (l1_only), 0.06363 (resample), and only 0.05500/0.05463 for the successor_geodesic_coarse variants plus 0.05500 for tangent_successor_residual, with target SID inside the 20 beams at 0.0678-0.0884 (upper bound on any recall@10) and gold-prefix survival dropping to 0.829 at depth 2 and 0.156-0.161 at depth 3 for the Euclidean variants. E7 teacher-forced NLL: l1_br 0.00/0.00/0.00/9.03 vs l1_br_euclid 0.00/3.22/4.36/1.23 - level 1 is already saturated and the real cost sits at levels 2-3. E8: K=16 shares a level-1 cluster for 0.3106 of canonical pairs vs 0.0822 at K=256, i.e. coarse level-1 helps. E9/E5: strong successor determinism (top-1 mass 0.4375 low-entropy quintile, Spearman -0.973) and cohort-profile signal 0.9291 vs 0.8871 support cohort-level successor anchors. E11 prefix signal is weak (0.0907 vs null 0.067). REASONING: holonomy acts exactly at levels >=2, where E7 shows the deficit and E6 shows depth-2 prefix loss, its geometry-off is bit-exact baseline (Euclidean transport is the identity), so the coupling switch is demonstrably real; HYPVOLCAP is well specified and within cost but its capacity-rebalance of level-1 is misaligned with saturated T1 NLL and with E8 favouring coarser level-1, and its Euclidean-off reduction is less clean; GROMPULL is the closest in form to the already-inert successor_geodesic arms (0.055) and leaves rho_i/R_j and the T=16 shortlist underived at +20-30% wall clock. FINAL RANKING: 1 holonomy-path-behaviour-rq, 2 HYPVOLCAP-RQ, 3 GROMPULL-RQ. Still open: seed noise ~0.003 vs a needed +0.002 over the 0.0636 resample arm; no arm is run, so this is a judgement on evidence fit only.

FINAL ANSWER (complete, stands on its own). Ranking of the three proposals for rank-2026-10-v1, best first, each grounded in the frozen evidence bundle.

RANK: holonomy-path-behaviour-rq | position=1 | reason=E7 shows level 1 already saturated (l1_br T1/T2/T3 NLL 0.00/0.00/0.00) while the real cost is at levels 2-3 (l1_br_euclid 3.22/4.36, tangent_successor_residual 3.17/1.67), and E6 shows gold-prefix survival collapsing to 0.829 at depth 2 and 0.156-0.161 at depth 3 for the Euclidean variants; the holonomy transport acts exactly at levels >=2 inside the residual recursion, its anchor table is grounded in the measured successor determinism of E5 (top-1 mass 0.4375 in the low-entropy quintile, Spearman -0.973) and the cohort-profile signal of E9 (0.9291 vs 0.8871), and because Euclidean transport is the identity its geometry-off reproduces baseline bit for bit, so the coupling switch is provably real; cost +6-10% with 120 no-grad refreshes = 1.3% of budget keeps it inside the frozen envelope.
RANK: HYPVOLCAP-RQ | position=2 | reason=It is the most fully specified entry (derived sigma_l 0.99-quantile, measured rho_max, bisection-inverted ball volume, behaviour-off = uniform rho, geometry-off = squared-Euclidean argmin) with a genuinely coupled assignment s_ik = (1-<p_i,q_k>)/sqrt(1-||q_k||^2) - cosh(rho_k) and only +6-10% wall clock, but its capacity rebalancing is aimed at level-1 dead codes while E7 shows level-1 already costs nothing (T1 NLL 0.00) and E6 shows depth-1 survival at 1.000, and E8 points the other way (K=16 keeps 0.3106 of canonical pairs together vs 0.0822 at K=256, i.e. coarser level-1, not a re-balanced 256-cell partition, is what beam survival rewards); the unmeasured T=8 refresh is a chosen constant and the Euclidean-off reduction loses the volume law, so the switch demonstration is weaker.
RANK: GROMPULL-RQ | position=3 | reason=Its behaviour-weighted geodesic hinge is form-identical to the coupling family the bundle already measured as inert: successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 (E6), all below the plain Euclidean arms l1_br_euclid 0.06207 / l1_only 0.06233 / resample 0.06363; the specification leaves rho_i, R_j and the budget scale undefined (E14 names them, the pseudocode does not), the T=16 shortlist and two-sweep references are undocumented defaults rather than derived constants, and it is the most expensive candidate (+20-30% Stage-2 wall clock) with the weakest evidence fit.

Objection: no ablation or seed arm is run, so this placement is a judgement on evidence fit only; E6 caps any Recall@10 at the target-SID-in-20-beams share (0.0678-0.0884) and the strongest existing arm already sits at 0.06363, so a >0.065 target leaves roughly 0.002 of headroom against ~0.003 single-run seed noise, and nothing in E1-E11 measures that code capacity (rather than depth-2/3 prefix predictability) is the binding bottleneck.
